headline: 今日影市零新片，剧集热度全面领跑
headlineEn: Zero New Films Today as TV Series Dominate the Buzz
summary: 9月21日影市零新片上映，本周仅一部新片入场，热度全面流向小荧幕。剧集《内格利》与《怪物：莉齐·博登的故事》霸榜，电影端靠《逃出绝命街》《生化危机：爆发夜》撑场，暂无重磅新片定档。
summaryEn: No new films opened on September 21 and only one arrives all week, pushing buzz toward the small screen. TV's "Nagli" and "Monster: The Lizzie Borden Story" top the charts, while movies lean on "Escape from Death Street" and "Resident Evil: Outbreak Night", with no major premieres dated.

industryHighlights.text: 今日零新片上映，本周仅1部新片入场，市场全靠存量影片支撑。
industryHighlights.en: Zero new releases today and just one this week, leaving the market reliant on holdover titles.

industryHighlights.text: 《内格利》同时登上剧集周榜第一与电影周榜第三，跨榜热度罕见。
industryHighlights.en: "Nagli" ranks No.1 on the weekly TV chart and No.3 on the weekly movie chart, an unusual cross-chart surge.

industryHighlights.text: 《怪物：莉齐·博登的故事》同时进入电影与剧集今日热度榜前二。
industryHighlights.en: "Monster: The Lizzie Borden Story" lands in the top two of both the movie and TV daily trending lists.

industryHighlights.text: 新剧《母狮》《MobLand》《绿灯军团》持续吸走观众注意力，剧集端供给明显强于电影。
industryHighlights.en: New series "Lioness", "MobLand" and "Lanterns" keep pulling viewers, with TV supply clearly outpacing film.

industryHighlights.text: 档期缺乏重磅定档消息，未来数周影市或延续新片空窗。
industryHighlights.en: With no major release dates announced, the box office may face a continued dry spell in the coming weeks.
